notes.title: Build 0.1.3 Update!!!!!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!!!!! First of all, thankies for wonderful wonderful launch of the demo, and all the positive feedback I got from it! You guys make me want to continue working on the game! I hope to make the best daddy/son rat incest VN there is!!!!! <3<3<3

Today, I have released a new build for you guys to enjoy. There's no new content, just some minor bug fixes and QoL. Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*]Edited one of the backgrounds to include a moon.
[*]Fixed a typo during the sex scene.
[*]Changed a transition to one of the CGs to be more smooth.
[*]Changed the graphic of the choices slightly.
[*]Fixed visual bug where Ron would go down instead of up when he went out of the car.
[*]Fixed visual bug where Ron didn't appear in a specific scene.
[/list]

I hope this adds makes for a better experience overall! Love y'all! xoxoxoxoxo
